summary: Aurinia Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K to disclose a patent litigation settlement with Teva over an ANDA for generic voclosporin. Teva stipulated to validity and infringement of two Aurinia patents expiring in December 2037; a launch date was set but not detailed. This is a routine legal settlement, not a corporate special situation. No terms on price, premium, or deal structure. The filing is informational only. Watch for generic entry timing and market impact, but no risk-arb angle applies.
